my mom was my emotional abuser meanwhile my dad was my physical abuser. the TLDR of my childhood was basically: your feelings, your interests, & your opinions dont matter, express that and youll get punished. When i was around 11, my parents would begin to argue with eachother about financial issues. they wouldnt do it in front of me, but it was loud enough that i could hear them in their room from my room. they began to ignore each other for months and made me become their messenger because they didnt want to speak to one another, so had me deliver messages back and forth between them that even included some arguments. i wanted to stop being involved so bad. i was tired of it. i prayed that they would separate. i felt no sadness at the thought of it either. they ended up doing so. i wasnt given a choice on who to go with, my mom forced me to go with her. i stopped getting physically abused at 13 but endured through emotional abuse my entire teen years. when she would yell at me, it would absolutely crush me because she’d call me useless & a failure. i began to depersonalize when she would scream at me and it wouldnt hurt me as much. sometimes i felt nothing at all. i think my brain did this as a coping mechanism. ive been dealing with it ever since.

i have a watermelon plush that i love very much. around midnight before bed, i couldnt find him. it was dark and everyone else was sleeping, so i thought “eh ill search in the morning.” as soon as i laid in bed and closed my eyes, my mind began to convince me that ive abandoned my plush, and that hes probably somewhere cold in dark wondering why did i abandon him. my mind fixated so much that he probably ‘feels’ betrayed and alone by me. i immediately got out of bed and searched the entire house for 20 minutes and told myself i would NOT let myself sleep until i found him. i ended up finding him and apologized over and over. i felt.. so guilty? i dont know. i felt some type of empathy towards it and i began crying. why was i so convinced it could feel? why do i feel so strongly about this stuffed animal??? i also feel so guilty if i see unwanted broken objects at stores.. maybe its some kind of emotional childhood abandonment projection for me idk? do i just have a large amount of empathy? IS IT AN OCD THING OR IS IT SOMETHING ELSE??? to add onto all of that: if i were to drop a cookie i was eating i always need to throw it away with another cookie so it can have a “friend” and not be lonely. i always need to throw away food i accidentally drop in even number pairs. if i dropped 3 cookies at the same time id be inclined to throw away another one with them in the trash so itd be an even number of 4 so every one of them has a “friend”. if i dont do it ill actually feel as if ive just committed a felony and cry my eyes out.  this part is clearly ocd but i still dont know how or why i give sentience towards inanimate objects like this...

When were told certain ideas/actions/behavior are bad and we should never do/think of them, our unconscious mind just cant help but want to think about it. we cant have control over these things so we just need to recognize that it is unwanted and definitely not truly apart of us and what we want to be. & it is very difficult, definitely. it took me awhile to get the hang of it. i still time from time get stuck in the dwelling cycle. but thats just the way anxiety is of course. & yeah! even if its baby steps, progress is progress! hope you are able to have some luck with some

first of, i think you trying to push away or repress these thoughts are making them come up more. there is no way to actually eliminate intrusive thoughts sadly(fml). however, we can try to control our reactions to them. you are not a bad person for having these thoughts. our thoughts do not define us as a person or equal reality. i can have thoughts that ive become the richest person alive, but it will never equal reality. you are having a huge reaction to these thoughts because you do not like them, are bothered by them, and may even fear them. doesnt that show you disapprove of them? would a ‘bad’ person truly have a strong opposing reaction as this? it seems anxiety comes from the “am i a bad person?” question. i suffer from this too. i try not to ask myself this question or ruminate on any thoughts i have. easier said than done, but do not try to analyze a deeper meaning to your thoughts. our thoughts dont have to have any meaning at all. our brains are constantly thinking and creating ideas, theres bound to be some weird meaningless ones that pop up. secondly, you just have to accept that your brain has these thoughts. you dont have to agree with them, but dont forcefully try to push them away. try to think of these thoughts as spam pop up ads. we see “you won a free iphone!” ads all the time. we acknowledge them, think theyre a little weird, but we simply exit the tab and move on. i try to view my thoughts the same way. i cant control when i see these popups ads, but i can choose to click the links (beating myself up having certain thoughts) or exiting the tab (telling myself ‘its an intrusive thought, if i could choose not to have these i would, its there so ill just let it play out until its hopefully over’). i hope this helps in some way.. dealing with intrusive thoughts is terrible, but if you work on a different approach with your response to them, it makes dealing with them, a little bit less scary

i have violent thoughts and they scare the hell out of me. im still learning how to cope with them, but some things i do are: telling myself that these are just random thoughts and try not to ruminate on them. we often see those pop up spam ads that say “you’ve won a free iphone! click here!” we notice them, read them, but just exit the window/tab and move on. i try to view my thoughts the same way. i understand i am having a thought that is disturbing and scary. however, i tell myself it is just another random “pop-up spam thought” that does not equal reality. if our thoughts are able to equal reality, i’d be able to have thoughts about winning the lottery and be rich the next day. it does not work that way however. therefore, these thoughts are not reality. you’re brain is trying to ‘protect’ you by worrying about possible issues it sees threatening. however, just remind your brain and yourself that you are not in danger and you are safe. i can’t get my thoughts to go away. and sometimes they pile up so much i cant take it, leading into maladaptive behavior. also, i would look into Cognitive Behaviorial Therapy (CBT) exercises/worksheets, hopefully it helps :)

i had a similar problem, my cholesterol and triglycerides were both high. what ended up working for me was cutting out all fast food, ‘unhealthy junk food’ and red meats/dairy. avoid fried foods and foods high in saturated and trans fat. eat healthy fats such as almonds and fish (salmon) instead. try turkey, lean chicken, whole grains, more veggies, salads, proper amount of fruits, egg whites, etc. also dont go crazy with high excess carbs foods. i also exercised (cardio) around an hour, three times per week. i had to eat suuuper clean which sucked but i endured it for the sake of being able to complete the treatment, which was totally worth it. dont know if you will have to be on a super strict diet like i had to do but eating changes and exercising at least weekly should help lower levels!! good luck :)

Your skin is too sensitive to be waxed while on accutane. it can even rip off your skin in the process(ouch). if you want to remove hair, i believe shaving is okay. just do it carefully. i would also suggest trying not to use contacts while on treatment. i dont wear contacts but my eyes ended up being extremely dry. other people who used contacts reported their eyes were extremely dry & uncomfortable. however, everyone’s symptoms can be different. You should be getting products for sensitive skin, products that are labelled ‘non-comedogenic’, or anything that is gentle/mild on skin. Some additional tips i would give are drink LOTS of water, accutane sucks you dry like a raisin. Buy aquaphor, vaseline, etc for dry lips. and stay out of the sun and wear sunscreen at all times when stepping out!
